title: 情侣牵手
summary: 一排座位中编号 2x 与 2x+1 是情侣，每次可交换任意两人，求让每对相邻所需最少交换次数。
insight: 从左到右固定每对座位；第一个人的伴侣唯一，若第二座不是伴侣，就把伴侣从其当前位置交换过来，一次交换最优且不破坏已固定前缀。
pitfalls: 伴侣编号可由 person xor 1 得到
交换后要同步更新编号到位置的映射

solutions.title: 逐座位对贪心换入伴侣
solutions.idea: 使用位置表常数时间找到当前人的伴侣。
steps: 若 row[i+1]!=partner，找到 partnerSeat 并交换 row[i+1] 与该位置，更新 position，answer++

code.java: class Solution { public int minSwapsCouples(int[] row){int[] position=new int[row.length];for(int i=0;i<row.length;i++)position[row[i]]=i;int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<row.length;i+=2){int partner=row[i]^1;if(row[i+1]==partner)continue;int partnerSeat=position[partner],displaced=row[i+1];row[partnerSeat]=displaced;row[i+1]=partner;position[displaced]=partnerSeat;position[partner]=i+1;answer++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSwapsCouples(row:IntArray):Int{val position=IntArray(row.size);for(i in row.indices)position[row[i]]=i;var answer=0;for(i in row.indices step 2){val partner=row[i] xor 1;if(row[i+1]==partner)continue;val partnerSeat=position[partner];val displaced=row[i+1];row[partnerSeat]=displaced;row[i+1]=partner;position[displaced]=partnerSeat;position[partner]=i+1;answer++};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minSwapsCouples(vector<int>& row){vector<int> position(row.size());for(int i=0;i<(int)row.size();++i)position[row[i]]=i;int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)row.size();i+=2){int partner=row[i]^1;if(row[i+1]==partner)continue;int partnerSeat=position[partner],displaced=row[i+1];row[partnerSeat]=displaced;row[i+1]=partner;position[displaced]=partnerSeat;position[partner]=i+1;++answer;}return answer;} };
